resources.string: Same page. Turn the page, or say next page.

string.name: book_say_resuming
string.description: Spoken when resuming from a bookmark

string.name: book_error_not_streaming
string.description: Spoken when the camera isn't streaming

string.name: book_error_capture_failed
string.description: Spoken when the photo capture fails

Couldn\'t read this page. Try again.

string.name: voice_welcome_short
string.description: Spoken when the book reader opens with the stream already running

resources.string: Book reader. Say read to start, or help at any time.

string.name: voice_welcome_ready
string.description: Spoken when the glasses are connected in voice-first launch

resources.string: Your glasses are ready. Hold the book open in front of you and say read. Say help at any time.

string.name: voice_connecting
string.description: Spoken while connecting to the glasses

resources.string: Book reader. Connecting to your glasses.

string.name: voice_camera_permission
string.description: Spoken before opening Meta AI for camera permission

resources.string: The glasses need permission to use the camera. Opening the Meta AI app. Allow it there, then come back.

string.name: voice_mic_permission
string.description: Spoken before opening Meta AI for microphone permission

resources.string: To hear you through the glasses, Meta AI needs to allow the microphone. Opening the Meta AI app.

string.name: voice_no_glasses
string.description: Spoken when the glasses can't be reached

resources.string: I can\'t reach your glasses. Check they\'re on, unfolded, and connected to this phone. I\'ll keep trying.

string.name: voice_using_phone_mic
string.description: Spoken when voice falls back to the phone microphone

resources.string: I\'ll listen through the phone\'s microphone, so keep the phone nearby.

string.name: voice_unavailable
string.description: Spoken when no microphone can be used

resources.string: Voice control is off because I can\'t use a microphone. The buttons on the phone screen still work.
You can say: read, stop, next page, say that again, go back, back a paragraph, faster, slower, where am I, battery, or close. You can talk over me at any time.

string.name: voice_not_understood
string.description: Spoken when speech isn't a command

resources.string: Sorry, I didn\'t get that. Say help to hear what you can say.

string.name: voice_nothing_read_yet
string.description: Spoken when asked to repeat before anything was read

resources.string: Nothing read yet. Hold the book in front of you and say read.

string.name: voice_rate
string.description: Spoken after a speed change; %1$s is the rate like 1.5

string.name: voice_rate_fastest
string.description: Spoken when already at max speed

string.name: voice_rate_slowest
string.description: Spoken when already at min speed

string.name: voice_where_reading
string.description: Where am I while reading: page, sentence, total, rate

resources.string: Page %1$d since you started. Sentence %2$d of %3$d. %4$s times speed.

string.name: voice_where_waiting
string.description: Where am I between pages: pages read, rate

resources.string: You\'ve read %1$d pages. I\'m waiting for the next page. %2$s times speed.

string.name: voice_waiting_auto
string.description: Spoken when asked to read while waiting with auto turn on

resources.string: Turn the page and I\'ll read it, or say next page.

string.name: voice_waiting_manual
string.description: Spoken when asked to read while waiting with auto turn off

resources.string: Turn the page, then say next page.

string.name: voice_furniture_on
string.description: Spoken after enabling page numbers and headers

resources.string: OK, I\'ll read page numbers and headers.

string.name: voice_furniture_off
string.description: Spoken after disabling page numbers and headers

resources.string: OK, I\'ll skip page numbers and headers.

string.name: voice_auto_turn_on
string.description: Spoken after enabling auto page turn detection

resources.string: OK, I\'ll notice when you turn the page.

string.name: voice_auto_turn_off
string.description: Spoken after disabling auto page turn detection

resources.string: OK, say next page when you\'ve turned it.

string.name: voice_camera_denied
string.description: Spoken when camera permission was refused

resources.string: Camera access wasn\'t allowed, so I can\'t see the book. Say read to ask again.
The glasses aren\'t reporting their battery. Phone %1$d percent.
I can\'t read the battery levels right now.

string.name: book_say_still_working
string.description: Spoken when a capture or OCR takes long

string.name: book_say_cant_see_page
string.description: Spoken after the last failed attempt

resources.string: I still can\'t read the page. Say read when you\'re ready to try again.

string.name: book_say_paused_by_glasses
string.description: Spoken when the glasses paused the camera

resources.string: The glasses paused the camera. Tap the side of the glasses to carry on.

string.name: book_say_glasses_back
string.description: Spoken when the stream comes back

resources.string: The glasses camera is back. Say read to carry on.
I can\'t see anything. Is something covering the camera? It\'s at the front left of the frame.
It\'s too dark to read. Turn on a light, or move closer to one.

string.name: book_hint_nothing
string.description: Image check: no page in view

resources.string: I can\'t see a page. Hold the book open in front of you, about a forearm\'s length away, and look down at it.
There\'s glare on the page. Tilt the book a little away from the light.
Something is covering part of the page, maybe a hand or thumb. Move it to the edge.
Bluetooth is off on your phone, so I can\'t reach your glasses. Turn Bluetooth on.
I can\'t find any glasses linked to this app. Pair your glasses in the Meta AI app first.
Your glasses disconnected. I\'ve saved your place. Check they\'re on, unfolded and nearby.
You took your glasses off, so I\'ve paused. Put them on and say read to carry on.
Glasses on. Say read to carry on.
Your glasses need a software update before I can use them. You can update them in the Meta AI app.
Glasses battery is at %1$d percent and they\'ll turn off soon. Your place is saved. Put them on charge when you can.
Your glasses are getting warm. Reading may slow down.
Your glasses are too hot, so I\'ve paused. Take them off for a few minutes to cool down, then say read.

string.name: voice_heard
string.description: Screen: last thing heard; %1$s is the text

string.name: voice_needs_setup
string.description: Spoken on voice-first launch when the app isn't registered with Meta AI yet

resources.string: Book Reader needs a one-time setup with the Meta AI app before it can use your glasses. TalkBack works on this screen, or ask someone to help.

string.name: book_reader_launcher_label
string.description: Launcher name of the voice-first entry point, so the user can say Open Book Reader
